about.title: A dairy from Gradačac. Flavours for the whole region.
about.lead: Mliječna industrija 99 d.o.o. was founded in 2015 through the acquisition of a strategic stake from Zott International GmbH, Mertingen, Germany. The company's core business is the processing and sale of milk and dairy products.
about.p1: The company is based in Gradačac in north-eastern Bosnia and Herzegovina, strategically close to the Croatian border and with good road connections.
about.p2: The company holds certificates for quality and management, production traceability and quality control, as well as an EU licence to export to the European Union – confirming that its products and processes meet the EU's strict regulations.
about.mission: Our mission is a satisfied consumer – together with the satisfaction of everyone involved in bringing our products to customers. Our best reference is a satisfied customer.
about.vision: To become a leader in dairy through continuous investment in innovation and technology, ensuring the premium quality of our Natura and Milkland brands.
about.peopleNote: Figures from the current mi99.ba website (no date given) – to be updated before launch.
about.marketsText: Deliveries are organised so that customers always have the freshest products available from our central warehouse. Each market is served by general importers and distributors.
about.factoryCaption: The Mliječna industrija 99 plant in Gradačac

production.lead: Our management places great importance on production quality. We are proud of our state-of-the-art equipment and the latest advances in dairy technology.
production.sterileText: Following a “fully sterile conditions” standard, milk is processed and packed in fully sterile, controlled conditions. This allows long shelf lives while keeping premium quality.

areas.title: Production facilities
areas.text: Automated raw-milk reception lines and CIP systems for uncompromising hygiene.

areas.title: Milk processing
areas.text: Pasteurisers with 15,000 l/h capacity for raw milk and fermented products, plus a mixing zone.

areas.title: UHT technology
areas.text: A UHT steriliser and TBA 8 fillers with 12,000 l/h capacity for long-life milk in Tetra Pak.

areas.title: Laboratory & quality control
areas.text: A modern laboratory; every process is monitored from control panels with clearly defined steps and procedures.

areas.title: Automated filling
areas.text: AVE bottle filling (3,500 kg/h) and HAMBA cup filling (4,500 kg/h).

areas.title: Packaging & storage
areas.text: A warehouse for UHT milk and packaging, and a cold store for fermented products.
